October is dedicated for breast cancer awareness throughout the world. According to World Health Organization, breast cancer is the most common cancer among women. articles.title: Ebola outbreak: Border surveillance gaps raise concerns in the Central African Republic
articles.description: The fight against Ebola poses a challenge in the Central African Republic.
